# Gambler

![Gambler](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/gambler.png)

Heads is a bet: 50% triple points, otherwise nothing.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 35%
- **Shop price:** 22 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 7 points

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** none
